children: Hyperliquid’s revenue over the past seven days rose 15.51% from the previous seven-day period to $21.22 million. According to Odaily, revenue over the past 24 hours was $3.22 million, ranking third among protocols behind Tether at $17.02 million and Circle at $6.74 million. Perpetual futures trading volume over the seven-day period reached $81.835 billion, up 14.35%, while liquidations totaled about $1.289 billion. Perpetual futures generated $20.57 million, or about 97% of total revenue. Bitcoin briefly fell more than 16% to $55,130 before rebounding above $60,000. During the price swings, position closures, hedging and liquidations may increase trading volume and generate more fees.

title: Hyperliquid’s 7-Day Revenue Rises 15.51% to $21.22 Million
